description:
CORRECTED via spike (2026-07-09, wt-spike-k22, negative result on fix a). Empirical tracing at HEAD (unfolded) shows fix (a) targets the WRONG bug for the current crash:

RUN/BUILD crash is native.rs:3127 env_runtime_var for ActivationKey{FunctionId(203)=reduce_while_cont, arrow Ty(291)}, Clause index:0 (the base-case [] clause returning the accumulator), acc ValueId(6) is Absent. That sibling closure-call site (span 2900-2919) is NEVER materialized -- so materialize_closure_call_edge / CallEdge::Indirect routing (fix a) cannot touch it. Root = clause-0 base-case accumulator demand-pruned as unreachable at the [int] (non-[]) accumulator-literal specialization while native lowering still materializes it. This is FIX (b) territory, confirmed empirically.

INTERP fails differently: backend callable 174 with 0 captures / 2 args ambiguous across [139,142,145] (ir_interp/backend.rs:2857). Might be capture-surface related BUT the multi-capture-arity signal was a transient mid-fixpoint artifact -- at settled state no capture-arity-1 boundary resolves to 174/181. Inconclusive; likely predicate-body over-specialization in most_specialized_callable_targets (backend.rs:2875), NOT captures. Cannot be cleanly re-diagnosed until run/build stop crashing earlier (fixpoint never settles).

Fix (a) also has a phase-ordering blocker not in the original estimate: arg_demands_for_summary (runtime_demand.rs) runs BEFORE transport boundaries, so the capture-surface fact (BoundaryDescr.published_capture_lanes) is not available at that seam without restructuring.

DECISION: pursue FIX (b) -- clause-0 base-case accumulator pruned-unreachable vs still-demanded at native lowering. Smaller, targeted, directly explains run/build, and a precondition for re-diagnosing interp from a settled state. Re-split: keep (b) as near-term unblock; re-open the capture-surface question (a) only after (b) lands and interp can be traced against a non-crashing build.

FIXTURE PATH DRIFT: fixture moved tests/fixtures/matrix -> fixtures2/behavior/enum_predicate_search.{fz,expected.txt,oracle.exs}; discovered by tests/fixture_matrix.rs via fixtures2/behavior.
title: fz-k22: shared HOF body reached by 2+ distinct closure CAPTURE surfaces -- the crash is per-call closure-capture evidence, NOT a settle-race or a convergence fold
